mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id as supplierId, supplier_name as supplierName, product, contact_number as contactNumber, email, return_policy as returnPolicy, on_the_way as onTheWay, COUNT(*) OVER () AS totalRows FROM v_supplier_list WHERE (CAST(#{search} AS text) IS NULL OR supplier_name ILIKE '%' || CAST(#{search} AS text) || '%' OR product ILIKE '%' || CAST(#{search} AS text) || '%') AND (CAST(#{returnPolicy} AS text) IS NULL OR CAST(return_policy AS text) = CAST(#{returnPolicy} AS text)) AND (CAST(#{onlyOnTheWay} AS boolean) IS NOT TRUE OR COALESCE(on_the_way, 0) > 0) ORDER BY supplier_name, product, supplier_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset};
SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name, id
SELECT id, name, category_id AS "categoryId", product_code AS "productCode" FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO suppliers (name, contact_number, email, image_url, return_policy) VALUES (#{supplierName}, #{contactNumber}, #{email}, #{imageUrl}, CAST(#{returnPolicy} AS return_policy))

INSERT INTO product_suppliers (product_id, supplier_id, buying_price, is_primary) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{supplierId}, #{buyingPrice}, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_suppliers WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_primary = TRUE ) )
